s.note: from the corn he grows in the park
s.how: Cut 12 corn tortillas into wedges and fry at 180C until crisp, then salt. Char 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels. Mix with 3 diced tomatoes, chopped coriander and the juice of 2 limes. Serve the salsa in a bowl with the chips.
Drain 2 tins of peach halves and pat dry. Grill cut side down in a hot pan for 3 minutes until caramelised. Serve warm with a spoon of Greek yoghurt mixed with honey, about 200g yoghurt in total.

m.note: cut one for Sam, the best dog in New York
m.how: Season 4 sirloins well and sear in a hot pan for 3 minutes a side. Add 50g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme and baste for a minute. Rest 5 minutes and slice. Keep a plain unseasoned piece aside for the dog.

w.note: from the last tins in the pantry
w.how: Drain 2 tins sliced peaches and toss with 60g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon in a baking dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, stir in 150ml buttermilk and drop spoonfuls over the fruit. Bake at 190C for 35 minutes.

d.note: the bottle Robert keeps in the lab
d.how: Pour 45ml bourbon neat into each of four tumblers. Put a few bottles of spring water on the bench for anyone who wants to keep a clear head. Lock the door before you pour.
